title: Effect of SP110 single nucleotide polymorphisms on expression of selected cytokines in a Ugandan population with pulmonary tuberculosis
authors: Denis S. Kyabaggu; Anna Ritah Namuganga; Jacob Muruhukye; Eric Katagirya; Bernard S. Bagaya; Rose Nabatanzi; David Patrick Kateete; Irene Andia-Biraro; Harriet Mayanja-Kizza; Lydia Nakiyingi
summary: Cross-sectional molecular epidemiological study of 153 adults with confirmed pulmonary TB in Kampala, testing ten SP110 variants against six plasma cytokines; rs7580900 was associated with lower IL-10 after false-discovery-rate correction.

title: Determinants of optimal number of ANC visits among women of reproductive age in Uganda using modified poisson GLM regression analysis
authors: Jacob Muruhukye; Kelly Taremwa; Christopher Tibamwenda
summary: Survey-weighted modified Poisson analysis of 3,477 women in the 2024 Uganda Malaria Indicator Survey, identifying the factors associated with attending at least four antenatal care visits (77.7% did so).

title: Factors associated with experiencing sub optimal birth intervals among Ugandan women of reproductive age using national surveys of 2000 to 2022
authors: Kelly Taremwa; Jacob Muruhukye; Christopher Tibamwenda
summary: Pooled analysis of five Uganda Demographic and Health Surveys (2000/01–2022; 28,059 women) showing suboptimal birth spacing fell from 89.0% to 81.8% and was linked to education, child death, unplanned births, female autonomy and ideal family size.

title: Precision Medicine in Africa: A Systematic Review of Genomic Resilience and Structural Gaps
authors: Jacob Muruhukye; Eleanor Sabuka; Anna Nakhabi; Mukisa Paul Brian; Nanono Gloria Margaret; Nabateregga Prossy; Eyong Peter Ebot
summary: Registry-based review of genomic and biomarker trials in Africa on ClinicalTrials.gov, set against biobank and H3Africa capacity; argues for investment in infrastructure, skills and data governance.

category_name: Short research articles and published abstracts
title: Dynamics of Zoonotic Disease at the One Health Interface: Evidence from a Systematic Review
authors: Anna Nakhabi; Jacob Muruhukye; Eleanor Sabuka; Christopher Tibamwenda; Lauritta Chinazaekpere Ndufeiya; Gloria Margaret Nanono; Olive Ebere Nwanja
summary: Re-examines zoonotic-disease trial activity in Africa using ClinicalTrials.gov; the corrected analysis places the real gaps in the global shortage of zoonotic trials, outbreak-driven research and neglect of endemic zoonoses.
topics: One Health; Clinical trials; Systematic review

category_name: Short research articles and published abstracts
title: The Antimicrobial-Resistance “Trial Deficit” in Africa, Re-examined: Why the Headline Statistic Fails and What the Real Gap Is: Antimicrobial Resistance Crisis
authors: Gloria Margaret Nanono; Christopher Tibamwenda; Jacob Muruhukye; Grace Kemigisa; Peter Ebot Eyong; Fiona Obbo; Prossy Nabateregga
alt_versions: Earlier version indexed by Google Scholar as “Health and Disease Burden: Antimicrobial Resistance Crisis” (Synthēsis 3(1)) https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=0k0jKDUAAAAJ&citation_for_view=0k0jKDUAAAAJ:zYLM7Y9cAGgC
summary: Tests a widely cited claim of an antimicrobial-resistance “trial deficit” in Africa and identifies the actual gaps: too few AMR trials globally relative to burden, no novel-agent trials in Africa, and concentration in South Africa and MDR-TB.

category_name: Short research articles and published abstracts
title: Community advisory structure in African clinical trials: A registry-based analysis
authors: Peter Eyong Ebot; Jacob Muruhukye; James Mukiibi; Spritney Nashua Ninpa; Christopher Tibamwenda; Meldwinel Ayuk; Prossy Nabateregga
summary: Text-field analysis of 23,873 African interventional trials on ClinicalTrials.gov: only 0.9% reported formal community advisory structures, yet trials that did showed better completion and longer follow-up.

category_name: Short research articles and published abstracts
title: The Bio-Digital Divide: Digital trial adoption and the Bio-digital gap in Africa
authors: Peter Ebot Eyong; Jacob Muruhukye; Rita Ewah Mbah; Endurance Lum Ambe; Vahid Esangaya Ntoung-Mbi; Spritney Nashua Ninpa; Gloria Margaret Nanono
summary: Compares digital, wearable, virtual and decentralised trial features in 268 African and 4,540 US trials; about 1.1% of African trials used them, roughly 17 times fewer than in the US.

category_name: Short research articles and published abstracts
title: Sickle Cell Disease Neglect: A Mismatch Between Burden and Research in Africa
authors: Peter Eyong Ebot; Randolf Fuanghene Wefuan; Jacob Muruhukye; Rita Ewah Mbah; Enu-Ma Obi-Asu; Spritney Nashua Ninpa; Ebere Olive Nwanja
summary: Audit of sickle cell disease trial registrations showing that research activity in Africa is poorly matched to the disease burden carried by African populations.

category_name: Short research articles and published abstracts
title: Research Archetypes and Cluster Mapping Narratives: A Semantic Comparison of Africa and Europe: Understanding innovation and evaluation framing in global Research Archetypes and Cluster Mapping
authors: Agnes Kindiki; Christopher Tibamwenda; Jacob Muruhukye; Prossy Nabateregga; Peter Ebot Eyong
summary: Semantic analysis of interventional trial descriptions showing that African studies emphasise feasibility and practical application while European studies more often use innovation language, with implications for global visibility.

title: Strengthening Urban Land Conflict Management and Tenure Security in Post-Covid Land Governance: Experiences and lessons from Lusanja and Lusanja informal settlements in Kampala City Region, Uganda
authors: Hakimu Sseviiri; Jacob Muruhukye; Disan Byarugaba
summary: Survey of 211 residents of two Kampala informal settlements on how COVID-19 affected land conflicts and tenure security; recommends inclusive, responsive land governance and policy reform.
